title: Object Matte failed under aerender
symptom: aerender failed to render compositions containing Object Matte
workaround_or_rule: Use a fixed host version; treat headless support as an independent capability boundary

title: Object Matte leaked stream-flag operations into Undo
symptom: Object Matte added spurious Set Stream Flags undo steps
workaround_or_rule: Do not infer internal stream mutations are user-visible semantic edits

title: Expression TextStyle changes failed to invalidate cached frames
symptom: expression-driven text style edits could leave existing cache frames stale
workaround_or_rule: Version-scope cache/invalidation tests for expression-driven text style

title: Compressed Disk Caching could crash
symptom: some configurations crashed with Lossless Compressed Disk Caching enabled
workaround_or_rule: Use hardware fallback/fixed versions; keep compressed/uncompressed paths separate in evidence

title: Cache purge could freeze on slow or network cache
symptom: Empty Disk/3D/All Caches could freeze while scanning large slow or network cache
workaround_or_rule: Treat purge as asynchronous/resource-control work rather than one blocking free

title: Media cache cleanup could hang on unsynced OneDrive entries
symptom: cleaning media cache could hang when entries referenced unsynced OneDrive files
workaround_or_rule: Model cache cleanup as external-I/O tolerant; do not assume local synchronous files

title: Mask Tracker failed below Full resolution
symptom: mask tracking could fail when composition Resolution was below Full
workaround_or_rule: Record preview/downsample state independently from source-analysis state

title: Essential Property values leaked across precomps in one Advanced 3D bin
symptom: Essential Property values were shared across precomps in the same 3D bin with Collapse Transformations
workaround_or_rule: Test per-instance render identity under collapsed/shared-bin contexts

title: Advanced 3D over-complex scenes crashed instead of failing cleanly
symptom: scenes too complex for the render engine could crash AE
workaround_or_rule: Treat renderer feasibility/resource limits as explicit failure states

title: Draft 3D plus collapsed nested comps could crash
symptom: enabling Draft 3D with collapsed nested comps could crash
workaround_or_rule: Use topology-specific regression fixtures for collapsed 3D paths

title: Coplanar Advanced 3D order differed from Classic 3D
symptom: coplanar 3D layer render order differed between Advanced and Classic 3D
workaround_or_rule: Do not infer one universal 3D ordering policy from timeline order

title: Variable-font expression animation caused performance/menu duplication
symptom: variable-font expression animation slowed performance and created extra font-style menu entries
workaround_or_rule: Record font resource/axis state in expression/text performance tests

title: Tiled EXR could render incomplete frames
symptom: tiled EXR footage could produce incomplete frames
workaround_or_rule: Use tiled-media fixtures when validating importer/frame completeness

title: Reveal Logging Files could crash after long logging interval
symptom: Help > Reveal Logging Files could crash more than 24 hours after logging was enabled
workaround_or_rule: Treat observability tooling as mutable runtime state with its own failure modes

title: SmartFX checkout_layer returned empty rects in older host
symptom: checkout_layer during SMART_PRE_RENDER could return empty rects
workaround_or_rule: Historical workaround was retry; no longer needed from 11.0.1

title: Dynamic flags can race with render and poison cached frames
symptom: render can consume state different from the last QUERY_DYNAMIC_FLAGS response
workaround_or_rule: Snapshot dynamic state; return flags and render from the same generation

title: PF_GetCurrentState is deliberately unusable in UPDATE_PARAMS_UI
symptom: state query returns randomized/unreliable state in unsafe UI context
workaround_or_rule: Do not derive render cache identity synchronously from UPDATE_PARAMS_UI

title: Kernel flags exist but host ignores several branches
symptom: REPLICATE_BORDERS and ALPHA_WEIGHT_CONVOLVE are defined but ignored; only USE_LONG coefficient mode implemented
architecture_boundary: declared API surface versus implemented host semantics
workaround_or_rule: Implement required border/alpha semantics yourself; test behavior rather than enum presence

title: Legacy Suite Handler can leak acquired suites
symptom: deprecated suite handler acquisition/release behavior can leak suite references
workaround_or_rule: Prefer AEFX_SuiteScoper or exact balanced acquisition/release

title: Compute Cache sample hashes pointer size instead of string bytes
symptom: sample passes sizeof(const char*) where textual tag length may have been intended
workaround_or_rule: Hash explicit byte count/string contents; never copy sample code without C/C++ semantic review

title: SmartFX PreRender may have no matching Render
symptom: resources allocated as if Render must follow PreRender can leak or corrupt state
workaround_or_rule: Transfer pre_render_data ownership to AE and support PreRender-only paths

title: GPU Smart Render worlds have null CPU data pointer
symptom: dereferencing PF_LayerDef.data during GPU Smart Render is invalid
workaround_or_rule: Use GPU device/world access; data is null by contract

title: AEGP references can become invalid after project edits
symptom: long-lived Layer/Stream/queue refs can become invalid after structural changes; even keyframe edits can invalidate stream refs
architecture_boundary: opaque handle lifetime versus semantic identity
workaround_or_rule: Store durable IDs/paths where documented and reacquire handles

title: Second command-line AE instance duplicates AEGP handles
symptom: saved opaque handles can collide/lose process-instance meaning when command-line AE instance duplicates handles
workaround_or_rule: Associate retained host state with plug-in/AE instantiation; avoid serialized handles

title: Mutable render sequence data is thread-local compatibility state
symptom: mutations made to compatibility render sequence copies are not shared/durable across render threads
workaround_or_rule: Use const render state plus Compute Cache/shared explicit synchronization for derived data

title: Source and destination cannot alias in host convolution
symptom: in-place use of WorldTransform convolve violates host contract
workaround_or_rule: Use separate output/intermediate world

title: Writing outside PF world rowbytes/region can corrupt cached buffers
symptom: assuming tight rows or writing beyond indicated region can modify unrelated cached image data
workaround_or_rule: Always use rowbytes and declared region; test with Grow Bounds

title: Classic stream ABI had compiler-specific padding incident
symptom: compiler inserted extra padding in AEGP_StreamValue requiring forced packing workaround
workaround_or_rule: Never serialize native structs or assume compiler packing across SDK generations

title: SmartyPants dynamic-flags mask erases unrelated bits
symptom: Alpha flag branch retains the target mask instead of clearing it; current SmartFX host impact unproved
workaround_or_rule: Clear the target bit with the complemented mask; flag is obsolete for current SmartFX

title: Old transfer macro intentionally preserves incorrect behavior
symptom: distributed SDK retains intentionally wrong transfer-mode macro for compatibility
workaround_or_rule: Use corrected modern path unless reproducing legacy behavior intentionally

title: Legacy project Shape/Camera layer twirl state can reset on open
symptom: Shape or Camera layer twirl state may reopen collapsed
workaround_or_rule: Restore twirl state manually and re-save project in current version

title: Mask Tracker failed below Full composition resolution
symptom: new Mask Tracker failed when composition Resolution was less than Full
architecture_boundary: analysis sampling resolution versus semantic mask coordinates
workaround_or_rule: Use 26.5+; test tracker semantics independently of preview resolution

title: SmartyPants 16-bpc Alpha blend coefficient is one too small
affected_versions: AE 25.6 distributed sample; source hash locked
symptom: 16-bpc alpha=0 blend=0 yields 32640 rather than 32768
workaround_or_rule: Use weights b and 256-b with 16-bpc M=32768

title: SmartyPants float Alpha ignores Blend
affected_versions: AE 25.6 distributed sample; source hash locked
symptom: Float alpha=0.25 blend=128 yields 0.75 rather than 0.5
workaround_or_rule: Apply the same affine alpha blend; retain existing wrapper bypass and quantization

title: SmartyPants PreRender ignores errors and publishes failed checkout data
affected_versions: AE 25.6 distributed sample; source hash locked
symptom: Ignored dependency errors can return success; failed checkout result is consumed
architecture_boundary: partial result validity versus output publication
workaround_or_rule: Preserve first error and publish rectangles only after all prerequisites succeed

title: Threaded SmartyPants rejects contract-valid null sequence data
affected_versions: AE 25.6 distributed sample; source hash locked
symptom: ActuallyRender treats null render sequence handle as corrupted despite threaded-render contract
architecture_boundary: persistent sequence state versus invocation parameters
workaround_or_rule: Keep channel and blend in invocation-local storage for synchronous iteration

title: SmartyPants float HLS and YIQ cross an invalid integer domain
affected_versions: AE 25.6 distributed sample; source hash locked
symptom: Extended or negative RGB can cause undefined floating-to-unsigned conversion
architecture_boundary: HDR real-valued domain versus normalized integer domain
workaround_or_rule: Use bounded float-native YIQ policy; reject unsupported HLS input; preserve unresolved HDR HLS and compatibility requirements
